how: scripts/crash-drill.sh <propose|approve|execute> <state dir>: run the production near:release for one pending NEAR redemption, SIGKILL the Node process the moment its journal records that step of that redemption as sent, record the journal phase and whether the chain already holds that exact extrinsic, then run again to completion and once more; compare the destination balance with the amount.
note: In the live path the approval does not execute: a separate execute extrinsic pays. The execute drill is the payment boundary: the payment was already on chain before the restart and recovery reconciled it without paying again.

drills.script: asserting version: refuses a started redemption, watches only new journal lines, exits non-zero unless every assertion holds
